subject: Re: Bin pickup time
text: Thanks for letting me know about the truck being early. I will put my bin out tomorrow at 5:30 instead of 6:00. Could you also move yours a little farther from the curb if you get home before dark? Last week the recycling truck knocked it into the street twice, and the side car had to slow down for it. I will grab it after the pickup and leave it on the driveway. If the truck is delayed or skips the block, I will send a note before lunch so we can decide whether to pull it back out for the alternate route.
